card.name: Words after PD-L1 expression in patient selection
card.fires_on: The small word or bracket right after "PD-L1 expression" (or similar biomarker status) in "select patients based on..." indications, such as "(" before CPS or "on" before tumor cells.

modes.label: Open bracket before CPS
modes.description: The "(" that follows "positive PD-L1 expression" and introduces a CPS cutoff.

modes.label: "on" before tumor cells
modes.description: The word "on" or "of" linking PD-L1 expression to tumor cells or tumor-infiltrating cells.

card.writes: It promotes tumor-related words, so it prepares the model to name tumor cells next.
card.plain: It fires on the small link after a biomarker such as PD-L1 in cancer drug patient-selection sentences, just before the tumor cells or score are named.
